title: A filter on a calendar's year keeps the filter on the month of the year

source.quote: All category dependencies of X. This can be thought of as all categories above X.
source.supports: the rule; in the lattice diagram Month of Year depends on Quarter of Year and Month of Quarter, not on Year, so it is not a dependent of Year

derivation: Year's dependents are Quarter, Month, Week and Date; Month of Year (MonthNumber) is none of them, so MonthNumber = 8 stays: August, 496.
